B-LOCALHOST-DIRECT.description: Oracle-free greedy decode on localhost-served payloads. Validates the decoder implementation without CDN.
B-LOCALHOST-DIRECT.expected: 240/240 byte-identical decompression output to ground truth under oracle-free decode

B-CDN-IDENTITY.description: Oracle-free greedy decode on uncompressed CDN payloads recovers ground truth.
B-CDN-IDENTITY.expected: 15/15 identity observations recover ground truth under oracle-free decode

B-ORACLE-GUIDED-REGRESSION.description: Oracle-guided decode on same 48-cell CDN matrix (not re-run; inherited from parent as regression baseline).

B-FIXED-ORDER-CDN.description: Parent fixed-origin-order decompression on same 48-cell matrix (not re-run; inherited as regression baseline).

observations: All 240/240 CDN primary matrix observations produce byte-identical output under oracle-free greedy decode (no SHA256 oracle).
All 240/240 localhost positive control observations pass oracle-free decode.
All 15/15 CDN identity observations pass oracle-free decode.
All 90/90 depth 3-5 observations pass oracle-free decode (3 payloads x 3 depths x 10 reps).
All 60/60 large payload (>100KB) observations pass oracle-free decode (3 payloads x 2 orders x 10 reps).
All 48/48 cache HIT test observations pass oracle-free decode, but 0% achieved cf-cache-status=HIT (all 48 DYNAMIC).

Cache HIT hypothesis untestable: Cloudflare quick tunnel free-tier does not cache responses despite Cache-Control: public, max-age=300. Zero HIT responses observed across 48 cache-populate + 48 cache-test requests.
All 6/6 cache stability groups byte-stable: raw body SHA256 identical across 3 consecutive requests for each payload.
Zero ambiguous tie-breaks observed on CDN: at every layer, exactly one of brotli or gzip succeeds.
Oracle-free decode method distribution matches parent oracle-guided: br=60, gz+br=60, gz=80, gz+gz=40 on CDN primary matrix.
Parent encoding-agnostic method distribution confirms deterministic decompression paths per cell.
validity_notes: CDN cache HIT condition is untestable under Cloudflare quick tunnel free-tier: all responses have cf-cache-status=DYNAMIC. The spec required >=90% HIT rate for C2 validity; this condition cannot be evaluated because zero HIT responses were observed. This is an infrastructure ceiling, not a negative scientific result.

Oracle-free greedy decode is semantically equivalent to the parent's oracle-guided decode on all tested cells because brotli (magic 0xCEB2CF81) and gzip (magic 0x1F8B) have distinct format signatures making the greedy try-brotli-then-gzip order unambiguous. No ambiguous tie-breaks were observed.
BINARY payload ground truth is PYTHONHASHSEED-dependent within-run only; cross-run reproducibility not guaranteed but not required for this experiment.
Cloudflare quick tunnel CDN edge was not captured in tunnel.log for this run (edge extraction regex did not match). This does not affect measurements.
The experiment uses the same seed (SEED=44) as the parent for deterministic payload generation, ensuring ground truth compatibility.
unresolved: CDN cache HIT (stale) serving remains untested: Cloudflare quick tunnel free-tier does not cache responses despite Cache-Control: public, max-age=300. A production Cloudflare deployment or alternative CDN that respects cache headers would be needed to test C2.
Oracle-free decode performance (amortized latency, CPU cost) vs oracle-guided decode not measured.
Behavior under concurrent load, HTTP/2, HTTP/3, or non-Cloudflare CDNs not tested.
